summary: Frontend-only testing of CodeOrbit landing site with three style variants. All 3 routes load correctly with expected testids, headings, and StyleSwitcher present with functional navigation between all variants. No console errors on any route. BOOK DEMO text on /bold renders with dark color rgb(10,10,10) (previous white-on-white bug is fixed).
critical_code_review_comments: Body background computes to rgb(0,0,0) globally (likely a global CSS rule for the dark V1). Editorial and Bold pages compensate by setting background on their root wrapper div. Not a bug (screenshots render correctly) but consider scoping the global dark body bg to the / route only, so if any page has flash-of-unstyled-content there is no black flash on light pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes verified: / (home-page, 'Command' hero, dark), /editorial (style-editorial-page, 'quiet art' hero, cream), /bold (style-bold-page, 'Crack'/'DSA' hero, yellow, BOOK DEMO text visible). StyleSwitcher links style-switch-root / style-switch-editorial / style-switch-bold all navigate correctly. No JS console errors captured on any route.
